scope: Independent offline operator-workflow review and saved-fit plotting verification; no hardware validation

resolved_findings.problem: A raw collection_protocol event could enter historical compatibility when the sibling completion report was absent or used an old schema.
resolved_findings.resolution: A protocol event marks the recording modern; a modern completion report is mandatory. Historical compatibility remains only for records without new protocol metadata.

resolved_findings.problem: Protocol procedure was validated against itself instead of the report and available raw start events.
resolved_findings.resolution: Protocol procedure must match report.procedure; passive_start/ringdown_start events must agree when present.

fit_review_plot_enabled_pytest.note: Subsequent test-only change skips the rejected-fit plotting integration case when optional matplotlib is absent; parent performs final complete verification.

reviewed_behavior: Collection validates requested conditions and the amplitude/duration pair before opening serial; metadata never substitutes for measured angles.
Raw protocol and completed run report are hash-bound; annotation templates remain explicitly unselected.
Raw review fits no model and selects no intervals.
Fit review requires explicit validation raw/annotations, verifies exact source hashes, session/reference/selection identities, fixed gates and original passive-method hash.
Saved coefficients alone produce ODE short forecasts and contiguous continuous rollouts; no refit, MuJoCo claim, export or acceptance change occurs.
Existing output paths are never overwritten.
limitations: Frozen ODE plots currently support packaged passive viscous and viscous/Coulomb fits; driven reports are rejected explicitly.
Dataset roles and requested release conditions are operator metadata, not independent proof of physical execution or unseen holdout status.
Raw review may leave an incomplete output directory if rendering or writing fails; absence of report.json means incomplete output.
Plot review does not certify global encoder calibration, cart stationarity, motor tracking or hardware RL readiness.
